listening.title: Huy's first morning on the team

lines.speaker: Trang (Tech Lead)
lines.text: Good morning, Huy! Welcome to the team. How is your first week going so far?

lines.speaker: Huy (New Developer)
lines.text: Good morning, Trang. It's going well, but there is a lot to learn.

lines.speaker: Trang (Tech Lead)
lines.text: That's normal. First, let's check your laptop. Can you connect to the VPN?

lines.speaker: Huy (New Developer)
lines.text: Yes, it works. But I don't have permission to open the Git repository yet.

lines.speaker: Trang (Tech Lead)
lines.text: I'll ask the admin to add you today. Meanwhile, please read the developer handbook.

lines.speaker: Huy (New Developer)
lines.text: Sure. Is there a guide to run the project in my local environment?

lines.speaker: Trang (Tech Lead)
lines.text: Yes, it's in our knowledge base. Follow the setup page step by step.

lines.speaker: Huy (New Developer)
lines.text: Great. Could you also tell me a bit about the tech stack?

lines.speaker: Trang (Tech Lead)
lines.text: We use React for the front end and Node.js with PostgreSQL for the back end.

lines.speaker: Huy (New Developer)
lines.text: Thanks. I will get familiar with the code and ask you if I get stuck.
